question: What is Diginex

beats.line: Diginex is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.
beats.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beats.action: Loose halftone paper documents drift down and lock together into one tile at centre frame.

beats.line: Its software helps organisations collect, manage and report ESG, climate and supply-chain data.
beats.headline: ESG DATA
beats.action: The stacked tile tilts up into a paper screen; small arrows feed data strips into its edge.

beats.line: Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project and Resulticks were folded into the company.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The screen flattens as four cutout building shapes slide in from the corners and interlock.

beats.line: That turns point solutions into an end-to-end platform, from carbon accounting to human rights due diligence.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: A paper ribbon threads through the four blocks and pulls them into a single continuous band.

beats.line: Enterprises face fragmented, manual compliance processes — banks and asset managers most of all.
beats.headline: ONE-STOP SHOP
beats.action: The ribbon band splinters into torn fragments, then reassembles against a cutout bank facade.

beats.line: As of early September twenty twenty-six, the stock trades at one dollar sixteen.
beats.action: The facade drops away as a torn arrow slides down the frame and pins a paper price tag low.

beats.line: Market cap sits near thirty-four million dollars, a sharp decline from earlier valuations.
beats.headline: ~$34M
beats.action: The arrow lands on a paper block, which contracts step by step until it is a small square.

beats.line: Integration is the main risk; general and administrative costs rose three point four million to eight point one million.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
beats.action: The small square unfolds into stacked receipts that pile upward across a calendar strip.

beats.line: Winning new logos, proving Resulticks synergies and slowing cost growth would change the story.
beats.headline: WHAT CHANGES IT
beats.action: The receipt pile is taped down and three fresh paper cards fan out above it in a row.

beats.line: The company has signalled a focus on Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market.
beats.headline: BRAZIL $77B
beats.action: The three cards slide together into a cutout map shape; a paper hand enters and holds it steady.
